sources.title: Homepage - lib.KALOS.art
sources.snippet: All the style reference images on LIB.KALOS.ART are generated by AI models, not by any human artists. The prompt contains "in style of {artistname}" or "by {artistname}" does not indicate that the image represents the true style of the artist. It only represents the reference results generated by the AI model using that prompt.
